hook: Aai! Agar tum Rasoi mein ho... toh Kuan par kaun hai?
hook_text: Aai Rasoi mein hai... Toh kuan par kaun?
feedback: Solid structure and brutal emotional twist! The hook (Cut 1) immediately grabs attention with the kitchen vs well contradiction. The reveal that the spirit wasn't trying to drown Chhotu but actually returning his already-drowned body delivers immense goosebumps and emotional punch. Minor note: ensure the transition between Cut 7 and Cut 8 maintains maximum visual continuity on Chhotu's eerie expression.
lines: Aai! Agar tum Rasoi mein ho... toh Kuan par kaun hai?
Ratnagiri ke us purane ghar mein raat ke teen baje choodiyon ki awaaz aayi.
Poornima ki raat, Konkan ke gaon mein kuan hamesha bechain rehta hai.
Varun ki aankh khuli, toh chhota bhai Chhotu bistar par nahi tha.
Bahar kuen ke paas Aai ki lal saree pehne ek saaya Chhotu ko bula raha tha.
Tabhi Papa ka phone aaya, 'Beta, Aai toh abhi Mumbai bus stand pahunchi hai!'
Varun ne daud kar Chhotu ko andar kheencha aur darwaza band kar diya!
Lekin Chhotu ka shareer ekdam thanda aur paani se bheega hua tha.
Sheeshe mein Varun ke saath... Chhotu ka koi parchhaye nahi tha!
Bahar Devchar usse khinchne nahi... dubey hue Chhotu ko ghar lautane aayi thi.
Raat ko kuen se choodiyon ki awaaz aaye, toh kabhi khidki mat kholna.
